title: ratchet: AGENTS.md is the only agent-instruction file with no line ceiling — the leak the 39-line clause came through
body:
Maintainer prompt (2026-08-18, PM chat, verbatim): 「尤其是需要这么大篇幅吗?对于skills的更新你也应该有规范。」 — asked while reviewing a PR that added a 39-line clause to `AGENTS.md` for what the facts table carries in 3 net-zero lines.

## The gap, measured

`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` now holds per-file ceilings for **all** `.claude/skills/**` instruction surfaces plus `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (11 entries after today's widening). `AGENTS.md` — the largest, most-read, most binding instruction file in the repo — has **no ceiling**. The ratchet's own case law (unprotected files grew +31% in one shift while the protected file held 0%) applies with the most force to exactly this file, and today's oversized clause entered through exactly this hole.

## Change

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` only: add a CEILINGS entry for root `AGENTS.md` at its line count on fetched main **after** the pending read-layer-clause shrink lands (sequencing: the hanging AGENTS.md PR is being reworked to a compact clause; set the ceiling from the post-rework text, the same set-from-post-review rule the four-skills widening used). Extend the self-test coverage case. Same shrink-only convention; raising later needs a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR body.

Serial: dispatch after the reworked read-layer PR (AGENTS.md) is MERGED — the ceiling must be measured on the settled file. Graded at filing by the skills seat: `pm:queue`, S mechanical (sonnet — correctness machine-judged by the gate on its own change; not a governed path).
